absence.detail: no ensemble manifest is published for any cycle the bank holds: every cycle and ensemble is listed in `absent` with its reason

members_rule: A published ensemble is a display-bucket manifest (schema tropics.members.v1, recon d091737 §4) in the ledger as product 'display:members:<ensemble>', vintage_key the cycle. n_members, min_members and taus are the manifest's own (its ledger meta); an ensemble whose manifest states fewer members than its own minimum is listed absent as too_few_members, with its url. A banked member parquet with no manifest is not_published; a cycle with no parquet is not_banked.
index_rule: Each object is a vintage-ledger row of the display bucket (tropical_file_vintage_in_force, source 'parsed', product 'display:<name>', r2_key = the display key), served as the ledger states it: url = https://display.energylake.io/<r2_key>. The API reads no R2 and fetches no object. The contract is recon d091737 §7's; d091740's spec was not readable when this route was written.

reasons.not_banked: the bank holds no copy of the NHC file this would be published from (the member parquet)
reasons.not_published: the member parquet is banked; no manifest is published
reasons.too_few_members: the published manifest states fewer members than its own minimum

not_served.object_bytes: This API reads no R2 and serves no object bytes: every url is the display bucket's, and the browser fetches it.
not_served.alerts: NWS tropical watches and warnings (api.weather.gov) have no route here: the page fetches them directly (recon d091737 §5).
not_served.member_points: No member point is served or stored in Neon: the points are in the manifest's members.geojson in the display bucket.
